text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—This year's "Sprinters Stakes" has gotta be Bamboo Memory!
She's definitely top-class in short distances, no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No way, the up-and-coming Daitaku Helios is riding high on a good wave,
so I'm gonna hype up Nakayama, ya feel me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...The moment you stand at the very pinnacle.
I shall witness it with my own two eyes.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll pour everything I've learned into my run and give it my absolute all!
I'm gonna carve my name into this Nakayama Racecourse!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Heheh—
The tension in the air is palpable!
This is gonna be the absolute best race!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Ayyy☆
Bamboo's getting totally hyped and going all out too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Helios...!
As always, it's hard to tell what the heck you're talking about...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Daitaku Helios. She's super high-energy and talks in a way I don't really get, but her running is dynamic and not to be underestimated...!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "My motivation is insanely god-tier today, so Bamboo, bring those vibes up too, 'k? Let's make this race super hype~☆"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I get that we're tryin' to make this a good race, yeah.
Just... let me say this one thing, though.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Today, I came to take the crown! I'm planning on blowing past everyone here, so you better be ready too, Helios!!!
